name: Gazprom transgaz Belarus (GTB)
note: General partner of HC Dinamo Minsk; GTB logo is on the back of the 2026-27 home jersey below the numbers and on the front of the away jersey. Propose severe: GTB is a 100% subsidiary of Gazprom (club partners page and GTB's own About page), the Russian state controls Gazprom, and Russia's war in Ukraine goes on — mirrors the existing Gazprom sponsor rating.

why.text: Gazprom transgaz Belarus is a 100% subsidiary of Gazprom, which the Russian state controls with more than half of its shares. Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022 and has been at war with Ukraine since. A famous jersey makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
